question: When and where was the Wonderbra's plunging push-up design first created?
answer: Canada in the 1960s. Louise Poirier designed the plunge push-up model for the Montreal maker Canadelle in 1964. The 1990s craze came when the licence changed hands and Britain relaunched it in 1994, with billboards of Eva Herzigova. A thirty-year-old design was sold as the news of the season.
move: The year a thing became famous is rarely the year it was made.
trap: Britain in the 1990s, when the billboard campaign made it famous.
reference: Jane Farrell-Beck and Colleen Gau, Uplift: The Bra in America, University of Pennsylvania Press, 2002
